description: Grotesk is a geometric sans serif typeface with extra-large spacing.

description: Again another "experimental" monolinear sans. Enjoy or not.

description: A contemporary take of the Times New Roman typeface by Lucas Le Bihan

description: Imago Mundi Mei is a psychogeographical typometric system that allows to create maps of emotional landscapes.

name: Interlope
description: Interlope is a script typeface. It is inspired by a lettering printed on the cover of the first issue of "Interlopes", a magazine published by the Homosexual Liberation Group of Lyon from 1977 to 1979.

name: Jgs
description:
Jgs Font is a font family made in tribute to Joan G. Stark (aka jgs, Spunk), a
pioneer of ASCII art.

name: kaerukaeru
description: A display typeface inspired by frogs and Japanese woodcuts

name: lack

description: Letters is a display typeface available in regular and italic styles. Designed for experimental use, it performs best at large sizes.
